title: Laredo Breaks Ground on Shiloh Bike Trails, Expanding a Rider-Built Network
excerpt: The City of Laredo broke ground Thursday on the Shiloh Bike Trails project, launching improvements to a trail network local cyclists have been riding and buildi
content:
The City of Laredo broke ground Thursday on the Shiloh Bike Trails project, launching improvements to a trail network local cyclists have been riding and building since about 2008.

District 6 Council Member Dr. Tyler King joined the Nov. 19 groundbreaking. The work is part of a larger plan to expand trail connections to recreational spaces across the city.

The project builds on trails that cyclists began riding and shaping around 2008 or 2009. The Laredo Cycling Association was recognized for helping establish the original trails and for supporting cycling in the city.

Official figures on the project's cost, mileage and completion timing have not been released.

For riders, the expansion means more route options as the work moves forward — and ongoing construction near the trails in the meantime.
